entities.summary: Mary Lawlor is Adjunct Professor of Business and Human Rights in the School of Business of Trinity College Dublin. An Irish national, she is currently the United Nations Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights defenders, appointed in May 2020. She is the founder and former Executive Director of Front Line Defenders and former director of the Irish branch of Amnesty International.
